gloss: at any moment; at any time

definitions.gloss: at any moment; at any time (without warning)
definitions.explanation: An emphatic いつ: at any time at all, with no warning. Almost always followed by 〜かわからない or 〜ても.

examples.japanese: いつ{何時|なんどき}⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}こる→起こる：01910_okoru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧わからない。
examples.english: You never know what might happen at any moment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いつ{何時|なんどき}⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧わからない。
examples.english: An earthquake could strike at any moment.

examples.japanese: いつ{何時|なんどき}⟦{呼|よ}び{出|だ}されて→呼び出す：04813_yobidasu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{当番|とうばん}→当番：04564_touban⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{携帯|けいたい}→携帯：00715_keitai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手放|てばな}さない→手放す：05338_tebanasu⟧。
examples.english: On my duty days I keep my phone with me, so I'm ready to be called out at any moment.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- いつ{何時|なんどき}〜⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧わからない: there's no knowing when ~
- いつ{何時|なんどき}〜て⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: whenever ~ might happen

WATCH OUT:
Here {何時|なんどき} is read なんどき. On its own, ⟦{何時|なんじ}→何時：00973_nanji⟧ means "what time" (and is occasionally read ⟦いつ→いつ：00536_itsu⟧ in writing).
